answer: Treat the network as a walled garden whose gate is a random-walk trust score seeded from audited founding agents. Each epoch, trust flows a few short hops along paid, completed jobs. A sybil nebula of fake agents can trade among itself endlessly, but only the few edges it buys into the honest region carry trust in, so the whole cluster splits a tiny score. Rewards unlock from the vault in proportion to that score, so 1,000 clones earn about what one does, while each attack edge costs real, slashable work for honest clients.
